local_frame: X radial outward, Y tangent, Z enclosure-up; rotate around global Z by angle_deg

microphone.connector_assumption: pre-soldered straight 1x6 header on empty back face, pins and plug point inward; purchased assembly not yet verified
microphone.board_fastener_requirement: 2x M1.6x8, head <=3.2 diameter and <=1.6 high; nut <=3.2 AF and <=1.3 thick. Candidate envelope, exact SKU pending.
microphone.base_fastener_requirement: 2x M3x10 with head <=6 diameter and <=3.5 high; choose nominal 5.5 AF nuts, max <=5.8 AF and <=2.5 thick; modeled AF reserve is sqrt(3)*3.4 = 5.88897 mm. Base feet must clear screw heads.

buttons.basis: Official family GQ12H-10M PDF; -N means silver on official page. Rear cylinder includes terminal space conservatively. Nut depth, print clearance and wire bend are engineering reserves.

feet.basis: Required minimum adhesive rubber foot envelope, exact purchased SKU and compression pending

limits: No valid exact STEP found for button/fasteners using step-parts search; documented envelopes used.
